game.name: Nfl Tour (Europe)
game.desc: NFL Tour is a side-step to other football games, instead of starting out in the NFL, you play with NFL squads made of real players and teams against other NFL squads on a road tour around the world. The more teams you beat, the closer you get to the contract. The game is more fast paced and action, it is a revamp of the old NFL Street games instead of the Madden games.
